title: Nutty, Chewy Irish Beef Stir-Fry
description: A hearty, comforting Irish dish featuring tender beef, crunchy bok choi, and a nutty twist. Perfect for a cozy solo dinner.

ingredients.name: 1 lb beef strips (flank steak or ribeye)
ingredients.notes: Slice the beef into thin strips.

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral-tasting oil with a high smoke point.

ingredients.name: 1 medium onion
ingredients.notes: Dice the onion into small pieces.

ingredients.name: 3 cloves garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic to release its flavor.

ingredients.name: 2 cups bok choi
ingredients.notes: Cut the bok choi into bite-sized pieces.

ingredients.name: 1 cup beef broth
ingredients.notes: Use a low-sodium broth for added flavor.

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a gluten-free soy sauce alternative if needed.

ingredients.name: 1 tablespoon honey
ingredients.notes: Add a touch of sweetness to balance the flavors.

ingredients.name: 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard
ingredients.notes: Use a gluten-free mustard alternative if needed.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup chopped walnuts
ingredients.notes: Chop the walnuts for added texture.

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper to taste
ingredients.notes: Season to taste with salt and pepper.

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley, chopped (optional)
ingredients.notes: Garnish with chopped parsley for added color and freshness.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the bok choi to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the beef broth, soy sauce, honey, and Dijon mustard. Stir to combine.
Return the beef strips to the skillet and cook until coated in the sauce, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the chopped walnuts and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
